subject: Intro: Jigsaw x Redwood — lightweight telemetry shim for LangChain
messages:
From: Jill Torres <jill@jigsaw.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@jigsaw.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Jigsaw x Redwood — lightweight telemetry shim for LangChain

Hi Markus,

I lead product at Jigsaw Analytics — we build observability layers for LLM toolchains. We've been prototyping a small telemetry shim that sits between LangChain (and LlamaIndex) runtime calls and vendor endpoints to emit structured traces and token attribution snippets.

We think this could be a low-friction integration with Redwood's hosted and dedicated runtimes: the shim captures prompt hashes, truncated prompt context, model variant metadata and a light-weight trace id to stitch together cross-service traces without sending sensitive PII.

Attached is a short proposal + architecture sketch (jigsaw-telemetry-proposal-v1.pdf). High-level asks:
- Quick compatibility check against Redwood SDK / runtime hooks
- A short sandbox (repo + creds) to validate end-to-end traces with LangChain examples
- A commercial pilot scope (3–6 week) for co-engineering and joint marketing if results are promising

Would you be the right person to start a technical thread? If not, could you loop in whoever owns ISV integrations?

Thanks,
Jill
Jill Torres
Head of Product
Jigsaw Analytics

Attachment: jigsaw-telemetry-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Torres <jill@jigsaw.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Jigsaw x Redwood — lightweight telemetry shim for LangChain

Jill — thanks for reaching out and for the clear proposal. This is squarely in the ISV integrations workstream. Looping in Vanessa (go-to-market for partners) and Karthik (runtime/interop).

Quick notes from our side:
- We like the design principle of capturing minimal context and hashing prompts for non-reversibility. We have a few guardrails around prefix caching and KV cache exposure that we'll need to validate against your collector.
- Karthik: can you do a brief compatibility read on the attached PDF and flag any runtime hooks we'd need to expose?
- Vanessa: from a partner/PS perspective, if we proceed I'd expect a short co-engagement SOW (2 sprints + docs + joint blog) and a sandbox acceptance criteria list.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik to provide a short compatibility checklist (by end of day Thu)
2) Jill to share any sandbox repo and test vectors (sample prompts + labels)
3) 30m kickoff Thurs 16 Jun 10:00 PT to align on acceptance criteria and access model

I've attached our standard LangChain compatibility checklist (redwood-langchain-compat-checklist.xlsx) — it calls out tokenization differences, streaming hooks, and what metadata we allow in telemetry headers.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-langchain-compat-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Torres <jill@jigsaw.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Jigsaw x Redwood — lightweight telemetry shim for LangChain

Thanks Markus and Jill — excited to explore. A couple commercial / ops points up front:
- We usually start with a 3-week pilot (tech validation + two joint deliverables: telemetry acceptance test and an integration README).
- Pricing: we can support a low-cost reserved sandbox for the pilot (covering ~200k tokens total); if the engineering work is heavier we'll price co-eng hours separately.
- Legal: when you share the sandbox repo please include a brief data handling statement; our security team will route a short questionnaire (SOC 2 self-attestation + data flows) if the sandbox sends any telemetry to external endpoints.

I'll set a calendar invite for the kickoff and share a short partnership checklist after the call.

– Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships (ISV & Alliances)
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Torres <jill@jigsaw.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Jigsaw x Redwood — lightweight telemetry shim for LangChain

Markus / Vanessa / Karthik — great to be aligned. Quick follow up from our engineers after your checklist review:
- We can toggle out any debug-level context; by default the shim only emits prompt hashes, model name, token counts and a trace id. No full prompt text leaves the customer environment unless explicitly enabled.
- Sandbox repo: https://github.com/jigsaw-ai/langchain-telemetry-shim — we added an example that rewires LangChain's LLMWrapper and emits mock trace events to a local collector.
- Test vectors: attached is an example set (we included short, medium and long prompts and expected attribution spans).

Requested items from Redwood for the kickoff:
- Temporary sandbox credentials (API key with sandbox tag)
- Acceptance criteria doc (to be completed in the kickoff)
- A short list of folks who will be on the pilot (eng + security)

I'll update the proposal doc and attach the revised sketch (jigsaw-telemetry-proposal-v1-revA.pdf). Looking forward to Thursday.

Best,
Jill
Jill Torres
Head of Product
Jigsaw Analytics

Attachments: jigsaw-telemetry-proposal-v1-revA.pdf (PDF, 490KB); test-vectors.json (JSON, 12KB)
